claims.A30: importlib.util.find_spec('pkg.sub.mod') raises ModuleNotFoundError when pkg is not installed, whereas find_spec('pkg') returns None, so a guard must test the root package first.

prereg.question: With the root package absent, does find_spec on a dotted name raise, and does a parent-first guard avoid the raise?
prereg.expect_if_true: dotted_find_spec_absent_parent shows RAISES ModuleNotFoundError; parent_find_spec_absent shows None; guard_parent_first shows False without raising.
prereg.expect_if_false: dotted_find_spec_absent_parent returns None (the simple guard is safe) or guard_parent_first raises.
